query:
with recursive deps(oid) as (
 select unnest(array['public.feya_commerce_product_drafts'::regclass::oid,'public.feya_commerce_configuration_prices'::regclass::oid,'public.feya_commerce_sellable_configurations'::regclass::oid,'public.feya_growth_registry_items_v1'::regclass::oid,'public.feya_growth_execution_requests_v1'::regclass::oid,'public.feya_growth_change_events_v1'::regclass::oid])
 union select c.confrelid from pg_constraint c join deps d on d.oid=c.conrelid join pg_class r on r.oid=c.confrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=r.relnamespace where c.contype='f' and n.nspname='public'
) select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',r.relname,'columns',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull,'default',pg_get_expr(ad.adbin,ad.adrelid),'identity',a.attidentity,'generated',a.attgenerated) order by a.attnum) from pg_attribute a left join pg_attrdef ad on ad.adrelid=a.attrelid and ad.adnum=a.attnum where a.attrelid=r.oid and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped),'constraints',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.conname,'type',c.contype,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid),'foreign_schema',fn.nspname,'foreign_table',fr.relname)),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_constraint c left join pg_class fr on fr.oid=c.confrelid left join pg_namespace fn on fn.oid=fr.relnamespace where c.conrelid=r.oid),'indexes',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid)),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_index i where i.indrelid=r.oid and not exists(select 1 from pg_constraint c where c.conindid=i.indexrelid)),'triggers',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',tg.tgname,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(tg.oid),'function',p.proname)),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_trigger tg join pg_proc p on p.oid=tg.tgfoid where tg.tgrelid=r.oid and not tg.tgisinternal),'rls',r.relrowsecurity) order by r.relname) tables from deps d join pg_class r on r.oid=d.oid

views.name: feya_commerce_v_growth_action_capability_safe_v1
views.definition:
SELECT item_code AS action_code,
    item_name AS action_name,
    owner_role,
    item_state AS action_state,
    implementation_state,
    public_summary,
    limitations_summary,
    config_json ->> 'action_class'::text AS action_class,
    config_json ->> 'executor_type'::text AS executor_type,
    config_json ->> 'approval_class'::text AS approval_class,
        CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(config_json -> 'production_mutation'::text) = 'boolean'::text THEN (config_json ->> 'production_mutation'::text)::boolean
            ELSE NULL::boolean
        END AS production_mutation,
        CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(config_json -> 'dry_run_default'::text) = 'boolean'::text THEN (config_json ->> 'dry_run_default'::text)::boolean
            ELSE NULL::boolean
        END AS dry_run_default,
    version_no,
    updated_at
   FROM feya_growth_registry_items_v1
  WHERE registry_type = 'action_capability'::text AND active_flag IS TRUE;

functions.name: feya_fn_execution_request_material_json_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feya_fn_execution_request_material_json_v1(p_row feya_growth_execution_requests_v1)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'action_code',p_row.action_code,
    'action_capability_version',p_row.action_capability_version,
    'action_class',p_row.action_class,
    'executor_type',p_row.executor_type,
    'approval_class',p_row.approval_class,
    'mutation_domain',p_row.mutation_domain,
    'target_scope',p_row.target_scope_json,
    'target_version_refs',p_row.target_version_refs_json,
    'request_payload',p_row.request_payload_json,
    'rollback_plan',p_row.rollback_plan_json,
    'postflight_check',p_row.postflight_check_json
  );
$function$
